outcome: Composite neonatal outcome (neonatal death, NICU admission, assisted ventilation, surfactant therapy, or seizures)
cohort: Individuals with singleton, cephalic, and term deliveries with a history of one or two cesarean deliveries from the Linked Birth/Infant Death data (2011-2020)
finding: While TOLAC was associated with higher risk of composite neonatal outcomes in women without prior vaginal delivery across all BMI categories, there was no difference in those with prior vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: TOLAC was associated with higher risk of composite neonatal outcomes in women without prior vaginal delivery across all BMI categories.
